item.description: Despite increased immigration tensions across the country, Rev. Alejandro Olayo-Méndez, S.J., emphasized the importance of migrants maintaining hope despite hardships.

item.title: Seitz Discusses Catholic Response to Immigration Crisis
item.description: As the country grapples with politically fraught immigration crises, the Catholic Church offers dignity and support for immigrants, according to Rev. Mark Seitz.

item.title: BC Beats Florida State 19–7 for First Win of the Season
item.description: Boston College lacrosse rode a red-hot second half offense to commanding 19–7 victory for its first win of the season.

item.title: BC Foundations Program Offers Back-Door Admission to a Few Wealthy, Connected Applicants
item.description: As competition for admission to elite colleges intensifies, many high school seniors battle for perfect GPAs, strong test scores, and robust extracurriculars—just to get rejected from their dream school. For some students applying to Boston College, though, a rejection letter isn’t the end of the story.
